correctness.rationale: For independent uniform group elements, the commutator equation is exactly [X,-X'][Y';Y]=0. For each prescribed rowspace S of dimension r, #A=product_{i<r}(q^a-q^i) and #B=q^{(2b-r)c}; the central coordinates are free. Dividing rowspace counts gives (1), summing yields (3). The product difference is bounded uniformly by (q^{2b}-1)q^{-a}/(q-1), proving total-variation convergence for fixed q,b,delta; extreme-delta ratios give the endpoint laws. The shipped stand-alone enumerator directly checks nine configurations including F4 and each observed subspace count.

value.rationale: The conditioned rowspace is a natural structural observable of commuting pairs in an infinite family of nilpotent finite groups. Its fixed-b critical window is a sharp, full state-space limit law: zero/full concentration on either side, uniform distribution on all F_q-subspaces at balance and an explicit q^{delta dim} interpolation. It identifies behavior not captured by total class numbers or class-size profiles; the exact scalar commuting count is not offered as novelty.
